localidad: RNA El Dorado, Sierra de Santa Marta, Magdalena
comentarios: natural vocalizations; calls from a male bird visiting the lodge feeders.  While at the feeders the bird would alternate between sitting at one of the feeders and sitting nearby on a dead stick.  This cut has been edited to remove the many other hummingbird calls from other species, since the thornbill calls tended to be quite quiet.
